title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability
abstract: arXiv:2611.05984v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyper-Connections (HC) architectures are increasingly adopted in frontier language models, yet their components remain insufficiently understood and introduce non-negligible training overhead. In this work, we systematically study the HC architecture to understand its components and identify simpler, more efficient designs. We find that learned read/write gating without mixing and unconstrained mixing with fixed gates form two effective interaction groups: either alone achieves performance comparable to mHC. We also identify repeated access to the expanded residual state as a major source of training overhead, even without mixing. These findings lead to SimpleHC, which simplifies the architecture by removing residual mixing and simplifies execution through shared memory access, using the resulting additive structure and shared gate inputs. Layer-specific gates share a group-entry state, enabling batched reads and deferred writes; scala

translated_title: 关于超连接的设计：简化、稳定性与可扩展性
translated_abstract: 超连接（Hyper-Connections, HC）架构正越来越多地被前沿语言模型所采用，然而其组件仍未得到充分理解，并且会引入不可忽视的训练开销。在这项工作中，我们系统性地研究了HC架构，以理解其组件并找到更简单、更高效的设计。我们发现，不带混合的可学习读写门控与带固定门控的无约束混合构成了两个有效的交互组：单独使用其中任何一个即可达到与mHC相当的性能。我们还发现，对扩展残差状态的重复访问是训练开销的主要来源，即使在没有混合的情况下也是如此。这些发现催生了SimpleHC，它通过移除残差混合来简化架构，并通过共享内存访问来简化执行，利用由此产生的加性结构和共享门控输入。特定于层的门控共享一个组入口状态，从而支持批量读取和延迟写入……
tldr: 该论文系统剖析了超连接（HC）架构，发现门控与残差混合可解耦为两个各自独立有效的交互组，并据此提出简化架构SimpleHC，通过移除残差混合和共享内存访问机制，在保持与mHC相当性能的同时显著降低训练开销。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically dissects Hyper-Connections (HC) architectures, showing that learned gating and residual mixing form two independently effective interaction groups, and proposes SimpleHC—a simplified design that removes residual mixing and employs shared memory access to achieve mHC-comparable performance while substantially reducing training overhead.
